<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b>ORLANDO, Florida </b>(<a data-tblloc="24x1" data-tblname="530655" data-tblv="27" id="led530655F2024341712247520566">May 11, 2026</a>) The LGL Group, Inc. (NYSE American: LGL) ("LGL," "LGL Group," or the "Company") announced today its financial results for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="530654" data-tblv="27" id="led530654F2024341712245536105">first</a>&nbsp;quarter&nbsp;ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="530654" data-tblv="27" id="led530654F2024341712245524742">March 31, 2026</a>.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">"Precise time is the invisible infrastructure behind modern defense technology,"&nbsp;said Jason Lamb, LGL Group Chief Executive Officer. "From space-based systems and electronic warfare to signals intelligence, targeting, secure communications, and networked command-and-control, these platforms depend on disciplined timing, synchronization, and frequency control to operate with accuracy, resilience, and trust. Through our&nbsp;ownership of Precise Time and Frequency, LLC, we believe we are positioned to build on that technical foundation, invest behind the business, and grow a technically differentiated platform serving mission-critical defense, aerospace, and communications applications."</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b>Results from&nbsp;Operations</b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><i>Total revenues</i>&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x6" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2024341712244242789">increased</a> <a data-tblloc="5x3" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2024341712244441983">$167,000</a>, or <a data-tblloc="5x4" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2026491778286107757">18.2%</a>, to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2024341712244456306">$1,085,000</a>&nbsp;for the three months ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="530654" data-tblv="27" id="led530654F2024341712244491614">March 31, 2026</a> from&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x2" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2024341712244465551">$918,000</a>&nbsp;for the three months&nbsp;ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x1" data-tblname="530654" data-tblv="27" id="led530654F2024341712244482025">March 31, 2025</a> primarily due to higher shipments in the Electronic Instruments segment partially offset by lower investment income earned driven by&nbsp;lower yields on investments in U.S. Treasury money market funds.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><i>Net (loss) income available to LGL Group common stockholders</i> was <a data-tblloc="15x1" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2024341712244924497">($622,000)</a>&nbsp;for the three months ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="530654" data-tblv="27" id="led530654F2024341712244491614">March 31, 2026</a>&nbsp;compared with <a data-tblloc="15x2" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2024341712244935623">($6,000)</a>&nbsp;for the three months&nbsp;ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x1" data-tblname="530654" data-tblv="27" id="led530654F2024341712244482025">March 31, 2025</a>.&nbsp;The&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="20x5" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2024341712245149375">decrease</a>&nbsp;was primarily due to non-cash incentive stock-based compensation granted to officers in January 2026, a slight decrease in net investment income, and higher materials and components costs partially offset by higher sales.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 6pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt;"><i>Gross Margin</i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Gross margin was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="17x1" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2024351712325949823">51.0%</a> for the three months&nbsp;ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="530654" data-tblv="27" id="led530654F2024341712244491614">March 31, 2026</a>&nbsp;compared to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="17x2" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2024351712325959568">52.4%</a> for the three months ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x1" data-tblname="530654" data-tblv="27" id="led530654F2024341712244482025">March 31, 2025</a>. The change in gross margins reflects higher costs of materials and components partially offset by higher revenues.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt;"><b>Backlog</b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><a data-tblloc="8x1" data-tblname="530654" data-tblv="27" id="led530654F2024341712243290844">As of March 31, 2026</a>, our order backlog was <a data-tblloc="21x7" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2024421714671931984">$1,525,000</a>, an&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="21x11" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2024421714671903164">increase</a>&nbsp;of <a data-tblloc="21x9" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2024421714671909662">$900,000</a>, or 144.0%, from&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="21x8" data-tblname="542608" data-tblv="27" id="led542608F2024421714671922087">$625,000</a>&nbsp;as of <a data-tblloc="9x1" data-tblname="530655" data-tblv="27" id="led530655F2024341712247164583">December 31, 2025</a>. The backlog of unfilled orders includes amounts based on purchase orders, which we have determined are firm orders likely to be fulfilled primarily in the next 12 months but most of the backlog will ship in the next 90 days.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left"><b>Investor Day</b></p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">The Company will host an Investor Day&nbsp;on Tuesday May 12, 2026, to provide shareholders, analysts and other stakeholders more detailed information on the Company's strategic direction, recent business developments and financial performance, and updates on strategic initiatives. Members of management will also be available to answer investor questions.</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">The Investor Day&nbsp;will begin at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time on&nbsp;Tuesday&nbsp;May 12, 2026 at the New York Stock Exchange, located at 11 Wall Street, New York, New York 10005.</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b>About The LGL Group, Inc.</b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;">The LGL Group, Inc. ("LGL," "LGL Group," or the "Company") is a holding company engaged in services, merchant investment and manufacturing business activities. Precise Time and Frequency, LLC ("PTF") is a globally positioned producer of industrial Electronic Instruments and commercial products and services. Founded in 2002, PTF operates from our design and manufacturing facility in Wakefield, Massachusetts. Lynch Capital International LLC is focused on the development of value through investments.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;">LGL Group was incorporated in 1928 under the laws of the State of Indiana, and in 2007, the Company was reincorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware as The LGL Group, Inc. We maintain our executive offices at 2525 Shader Road, Orlando, Florida 32804. Our telephone number is (407) 298-2000. Our Internet address is&nbsp;<u>www.lglgroup.com</u>. LGL Group common stock is&nbsp;traded on the NYSE American under the symbol "LGL".</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;">LGL Group's business strategy is primarily focused on growth through expanding new and existing operations across diversified industries. The Company's engineering and design origins date back to the early 1900s. In 1917, Lynch Glass Machinery Company ("Lynch Glass"), the predecessor of LGL Group, was formed and emerged in the late 1920s as a successful manufacturer of glass-forming machinery. Lynch Glass&nbsp;was then renamed Lynch Corporation ("Lynch") and was incorporated in 1928 under the laws of the State of Indiana. In 1946, Lynch was listed on the "New York Curb Exchange," the predecessor to the NYSE American. The Company has a had a long history of owning and operating various business in the precision engineering, manufacturing, and services sectors.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt;"><b>Cautionary Note&nbsp;Concerning Forward-Looking Statements</b></p>

			<td id=".trail.5" nowrap="true" style="width: 1%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 0pt; border-bottom: 3px double rgb(0, 0, 0);"><b>%)</b></td>
